objective: AUTOMATION-002 — Foundation: Trigger schema expansion in frontend IR and TriggerConfig shared primitive in backend ScriptCache

acceptance.criterion: TriggerSchema in hydragrow-frontend/src/lib/automation/ir.ts supports sensor, fsm, cron, and webhook discriminated union variants.
acceptance.verification: Vitest test suite passes for ir.test.ts verifying sensor, fsm, cron, and webhook trigger parsing and defaults.

acceptance.criterion: TriggerConfig::from_ir_json in hydragrow-backend/src/services/script_engine.rs parses sensor, fsm, cron, and webhook triggers with safe fallback to Sensor on malformed/missing fields.
acceptance.verification: Cargo unit tests pass for TriggerConfig::from_ir_json variants and fallbacks.

acceptance.criterion: CachedScript incorporates the trigger: TriggerConfig field populated during reload_device and upsert.
acceptance.verification: Cargo unit tests pass verifying CachedScript trigger field population.

acceptance.criterion: ScriptCache provides list_cron_scripts and get_webhook_scripts accessors returning matching scripts across devices.
acceptance.verification: Cargo unit tests pass for ScriptCache::list_cron_scripts and ScriptCache::get_webhook_scripts.
